note: Set A binds the louver counts to the operable screen bay and keeps the Flexinol force/temperature facts distinct, and its chart readings carry numeric values with the nickel-content condition. Set B repeats the 400 g, 2900 g, 2500 g, 15–20 C and louver facts under a misspelled "Flexnoll® actuator" entity, misbinds the 64/32 louvers and the 15–20 C Irvine range to the actuator, and misbinds the 2500 g wire load to the spring. B also emits two chart claims whose "value" is just the label "Ms °C" and gives two conflicting readings at ~50 at.% Ni (50 C and 0 °C). Both sets share the same garbled "cool force" quote and the unsupported Ms = -100 C at 53 at.% Ni point.
remarks: Both sets quote "specified wire provided a 2500 gram force during the cool force"; the page reads "The specified wire allowed a 2500 gram force during the cool, martensite phase", so the condition (martensite phase) is lost and the verb misquoted in both. Both also claim Ms = -100 C at 53 at.% Ni, but the plotted data in the chart appears to end near 51.5 at.% Ni, so that point is likely invented; the chart is a scatter plot of literature data (Harrison et al., Han et al.) and single-value readings at given Ni contents are approximate at best. Set B's repeated "Flexnoll®" spelling is a consistent OCR/label misread of Flexinol®. Neither set captures the two mirrored independent assemblies per bay.
